site_ui.lead: Follow practitioner workflows for finding surplus funds, verifying claimant entitlement and competing debt, reaching owners and heirs, and moving documented claims toward recovery.
site_ui.summary: All 12 chapters synthesize 192 verbatim YouTube practitioner testimonies with timestamped inline attribution. They trace surplus recovery from free-list research and claimant outreach through agreements, claim submission, state-specific timing, and payout risks, distinguishing reported recoveries and collected fees from contracted or expected income.

flow: Search county surplus and excess-proceeds records, compare auction results, and learn how the holding office publishes balances and claim instructions.
Confirm funds remain, check existing claims and deadlines, and research ownership and competing debt as they stood at the sale.
Identify the correct claimant, trace current contact details, and examine deeds and death dates when heirs or estates may be involved.
Use calls, texts, and letters to reach claimants, address distrust with evidence, and keep a record of each contact and follow-up.
Secure the applicable agreement and claim paperwork, resolve identification gaps, and check originals, notarization, and attorney needs.
Submit to the appropriate holding office, follow the claim through processing, and distinguish recovery proceeds, owner allocations, expenses, and collected fees.
